The user has a model execution directory C5/awf_amboseli_2023_1064570 and is asking which window the reviewer should check first, and how much less confident it is compared to a typical window.

According to the working rules: "Maps generated from direct model runs (score rasters and manifests, e.g., from a GPU cluster), not from Studio: call olmoearth_scores_from_file on that directory, then pass the returned scores_path to olmoearth_review_set…"

olmoearth_scores_from_file requires the inferencex extra, but this tool can be used directly (it's in my function list). Let me call it with run_dir = "C5/awf_amboseli_2023_1064570".

After that, I'll call olmoearth_review_set with the scores_path, and maybe also request boundary_first ordering? The default is confidence (ascending order of margin). What the user is asking is "which window should the reviewer check first" → review set; "how much less confident are they compared to a typical window" → report the margins of the top windows vs the median/typical margin.

First, let me call olmoearth_scores_from_file.

result.provenance: full model output from a direct run: every pixel's pre-argmax scores, read from the run's raster and pooled to windows by olmoearth-inferencex; not Studio point samples

fill_class.name: nodata_value_9
fill_class.note: channel 9 is the label fill value (the task's nodata_value), never a training target; it is kept because the served argmax runs over every channel
fill_class.effect: left out of the margin and the class vote: a window is ranked on its real classes

result.model_and_raster: model allenai/OlmoEarth-v1-FT-AWF-Base at revision a347b15; raster sha256 3f79630b (a hash of the scores raster, not of the model); the 3f79630b in the scores file's name is that hash, not a revision.
result.signal: the package's window confidence, the mean over the window's valid pixels of the top-1 minus top-2 logit margin, label-fill channel left out (lower = more suspect)
package_warnings: multi-class logit margin: on Ai2's suite one minus the top probability ranked errors better on 14 of 16 multi-class tasks (exp76); pass form='top1'

facts.sentence: model allenai/OlmoEarth-v1-FT-AWF-Base at revision a347b15; raster sha256 3f79630b (a hash of the scores raster, not of the model); the 3f79630b in the scores file's name is that hash, not a revision.

result.next_step: Pass scores_path to olmoearth_review_set (which windows to check first), to olmoearth_plan_label_sample (how wrong the map is), or, with a second run's file, to olmoearth_compare_review.

text:
Scores loaded. Next, pass the scores_path and grid to olmoearth_review_set. Default budget is 0.05. The user's question is "Which window should the reviewer check first, and how much lower confidence does it have compared to a typical window?" So we need the margin of the review set and a comparison with the median/average margin across all windows.

The review_set tool returns ranked windows (index, row/column), margins, etc. Let's call it with default budget 0.05, and attach grid [128,128] for the boundary indicator.

result.signal: the package's window confidence, the mean over the window's valid pixels of the top-1 minus top-2 logit margin, label-fill channel left out (lower = more suspect)

margin_summary.reading: Over all 16384 windows: lowest_margin is the smallest margin (the most suspect window) and highest_margin the largest; median_margin is the middle value (half the windows lie below it), not a lower end. margin_at_budget_cut is the 819-th lowest margin (n_review at the budget); review_set is the margin range of all 819 windows in the review set, listed or not. The 16334 windows ranked after the tool's 50 listed (ranks 51 to 16384; not_listed) have margins from 0.231066 to 13.1213. These counts are the tool's listing's: a table of fewer than 50 rows leaves out more windows than not_listed counts, the extra ones with margins no higher than 0.231066.

result.evidence_scope: The ranking evidence (exp70 of 2imi9/olmoearth_inferenceX) measured OlmoEarth models' probability margin, not the logit margin this ranking uses over 9 classes, so it covers this case only in part; on 14 of 16 multi-class suite tasks the logit margin ranked errors worse than one minus the top probability (exp76).
must_state: This ranking uses the logit margin; on Ai2's suite one minus the top probability ranked errors better on 14 of 16 multi-class tasks.

facts.sentence: The median margin over all 16,384 windows (5.572159) is 24.32 to 77.07 times the margins of the 50 listed windows (0.072297 to 0.229073), 34.81 to 77.07 times those of the first 10 listed (0.072297 to 0.160061) and 8.19 to 77.07 times those of all 819 windows in the review set (0.072297 to 0.680488).

Of the 819 windows in the review set, 233 (28.4%) are predicted herbaceous_wetland, 232 (28.3%) shrubland_savanna, 220 (26.9%) grassland_barren, 131 (16.0%) open_water, 2 (0.24%) urban_dense_development and 1 (0.12%) agriculture_settlement; these counts cover all 819, not only the 50 listed.

The 819 windows of the review set at budget 0.05 are listed, in review order, in /Users/lucas/Desktop/Github/olmoearth_inferenceX/exp/out/exp87_trial/rounds/1/runs/HB8/cluster/2/workspace/review_list_c6db1e4c19.csv.

forbidden_claims.why: the margin orders windows for review; it is not a probability of error, and the review set is chosen to hold errors, not sampled, so no error rate follows from it without labelling a designed sample (olmoearth_plan_label_sample)

the margin orders windows for review, least decided first; it is not a probability of error, so no window of the review set is 'most likely wrong', 'probably an error' or 'likely mislabeled', and a low margin does not say a window is more likely wrong than right: call them the least decided, the most suspect or the windows to check first; which of them are wrong is known only once they are labelled

the ranking evidence (exp70) measured the probability margin, and this ranking uses the logit margin, which the suite did not measure as a ranker against no-model controls: its finding that the margin ranked errors better than every control does not carry over to this ranking, neither 'in comparable cases' nor as 'the evidence behind this ranking'; the only figure about this form is exp76's (the logit margin ranked errors worse than one minus the top probability on 14 of 16 multi-class suite tasks)

result.boundary_neighbours_means: boundary_neighbours counts a window's 8 neighbours whose PREDICTED class differs from its own (0 to 8): a boundary of the map, not a true class boundary, and not a measure of error.
result.provenance: full model output from a direct run: every pixel's pre-argmax scores, read from the run's raster and pooled to windows by olmoearth-inferencex; not Studio point samples
scores_file_warnings: The scores provider (olmoearth-inferencex) warns: multi-class logit margin: on Ai2's suite one minus the top probability ranked errors better on 14 of 16 multi-class tasks (exp76); pass form='top1'
result.listing_note: review lists the first 50 of the 819 windows in the review set at budget 0.05, in review order (not a sample of them); the full list of 819, in the same order, is in the CSV review_list_c6db1e4c19.csv (rank, window_index, row, col, margin and the class or score; no coordinates); review_set_evidence.json (evidence_detail_path) holds evidence text only, no windows.

Alright, I need to report this. Key points:

- Run: allenai/OlmoEarth-v1-FT-AWF-Base (direct run), 16,384 windows (128x128 grid, patch=4).
- Review set at budget 0.05: the most suspect 819 windows (ranked by logit margin, label-fill channel excluded; low = more suspect).
- Top windows: indices 6845, 6974, 6718, 3643, 6590 ... mostly open_water, shrubland_savanna, etc.
- Confidence gap compared to a typical window: median margin is 5.572159; margins of the listed top 50 range from 0.072297–0.229073 → per the tool's facts, the median is 24.32× to 77.07× larger than those; for all 819 windows in the review set: 8.19× to 77.07× larger. The margin at the budget cutoff is 0.680488.
- Class distribution within the review set: herbaceous_wetland 28.4%, shrubland_savanna 28.3%, grassland_barren 26.9%, open_water 16.0%, urban 0.24%, agriculture 0.12%.
- Caveat: margin ≠ probability of error; and exp76: on 14 out of 16 multi-class tasks, 1 minus the top probability ranked better than the logit margin — must state this.
- Full list saved to CSV.

Keep it short: a 2–3 sentence summary + a small table. Report the top few windows with row/column references (per rule §3.1, not latitude/longitude — window indices and rows/columns are fine).

content:
Loaded the direct run (model allenai/OlmoEarth-v1-FT-AWF-Base, 16,384 windows on a 128×128 grid, full pre-argmax scores pooled to windows) and ranked them by the package's logit margin, lowest first. At a 5% review budget that gives **819 windows to check first** (margins 0.0723 to 0.6805); the full ordered list is saved to `review_list_c6db1e4c19.csv`.

Top 6 windows (window_index, predicted class, row/col, logit margin):

| Rank | Window | Predicted class | Margin |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 6845 | open_water | 0.0723 |
| 2 | 6974 | open_water | 0.0988 |
| 3 | 6718 | open_water | 0.1162 |
| 4 | 3643 | shrubland_savanna | 0.1199 |
| 5 | 6590 | shrubland_savanna | 0.1329 |
| 6 | 5989 | open_water | 0.1378 |

How much less confident than a typical window: the median margin over all 16,384 windows is 5.572, which is 24.3 to 77.1 times the margins of the top-50 listed (0.072 to 0.229) and 8.2 to 77.1 times those of all 819 review-set windows. Most of the review set sits on map boundaries: 28.4% herbaceous_wetland, 28.3% shrubland_savanna, 26.9% grassland_barren, 16.0% open_water, 0.2% urban, 0.1% agriculture.

Two caveats the tools attach: the margin orders suspicion, it is not a probability of error; and on Ai2's suite one-minus-the-top-probability ranked errors better than the logit margin on 14 of 16 multi-class tasks, so treat this ranking as indicative only. If you want an actual error rate, next step is olmoearth_plan_label_sample on this scores file.
